name: Dindigul
zones: Dindigul SIDCO, Nagal Nagar, Vedasandur, Nilakottai
intro: An hour and a half up NH 44 from Madurai: free-cutting brass and flat bars for Dindigul's lock makers, and EN8 shafting for the spinning mills of Vedasandur and Nilakottai, delivered the same day.

name: Rajapalayam
intro: Rollers, spindles and bushes for the spinning and surgical-cotton mills of Rajapalayam and Srivilliputhur, sent down on our Sivakasi-route truck the same day.

name: Theni
intro: Pipes, angles and shafting for the mills, pump-set and farm-equipment workshops of Theni, Bodi and Cumbum, with stainless sheet for the spice and food processors of the valley.

name: Karaikudi
intro: Beams, channels and hollow sections for the fabricators and builders of Karaikudi and the Chettinad belt, crane-loaded at our Madurai godowns and delivered next day.

name: Pudukkottai
intro: Cast iron bars, plates and alloy rounds for the foundries and engineering units around SIPCOT Pudukkottai and Mathur, delivered next day.

name: Thanjavur
intro: Plates, shafts and bushes for the rice-mill, farm-equipment and sugar-mill workshops of the Cauvery delta, from Thanjavur to Kumbakonam and Pattukkottai.

name: Nagercoil
zones: Nagercoil, Konam industrial estate, Marthandam, Colachel
intro: Marine-grade 316 and 5083 aluminium for the boatyards of Colachel, and sections and pipes for the builders of Kanyakumari district, on our Tirunelveli-route truck.
